_comment: Topology of the issue lifecycle axis: every node, the schema each edge carries, gates, failure policy and width budget. scripts/validate-workflow-graph.ts enforces it; see docs/adr/0003-workflow-graph-contract.md. runtime: conversational = needs mid-run human interaction, stays in the main agent; workflow = graphable island runnable as a Workflow script; chain = sequential and deliberately not a graph. Schema bodies land in NER-246; workflow scripts must inline them as `const SCHEMA_<Name> = {...}`, which is what the drift check reads.

schemas.description: The filed issue: objective, scope, acceptance criteria, constraints.
Vault recall for the project: entity page sections, decisions, 1-hop graph.

The in-repo half of the plan context, gathered in parallel: repo layout, prior plans, related issues, ADRs. The vault half travels separately as ProjectContext, because a node belongs to exactly one skill.
The plan posted to Linear as a `## Implementation plan` comment.
Commits pushed to the issue branch plus the draft PR that tracks them.
The review the user picked: dimensions to cover and the change range to read.
Verified findings (a list of the ReviewFinding shape from NER-246) with their verdicts.
The `## Session summary` comment: what changed, what remains, validation, next steps.
The merged PR/MR, the checkout switched to the base branch, the issue set to Done.
The entity page edit plus the index/log upkeep that goes with it.

gates.description: The user approves the drafted issue before anything is written to Linear.

failure.fallback: continue without vault context and flag the gap in the plan
degrade to the sequential context read in the main agent

gates.description: The human sets the issue to In Progress in Linear; no repo change happens before that.

failure.fallback: fall back to the user reviewing the PR manually

gates.description: The user picks the reviewer; the runtime takes no mid-run input, so this cannot move inside review-verify.

failure.fallback: report partial findings and mark the run incomplete
stop and report (merge conflict, missing gh/glab)

gates.description: The human asks to close, or sets the issue to Done with the PR still open; the merge is irreversible.

failure.fallback: skip the wiki write and report it to the user
